audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Sett wins Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and 6, contradicting the packet chart (Sett, Skill, Aatrox, Aatrox, Aatrox, Aatrox, Skill), the 49.3% win rate, the content-layer whys text, and the already-audited mirror (aatrox__sett).
audit.why: Both layers rendered 'Sett' while the prose directly under them said Aatrox out-trades from 3 onward. Mirror findings state: Level 2 evens to Skill; Levels 3 through First item belong to Aatrox; Two+ items stays Skill.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Sett / Skill / Aatrox / Aatrox / Aatrox / Aatrox / Skill in both layers, proposed as one atomic group with matching phases[N].side + win[N] pairs and rewritten phases[N].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose carried no real cooldown numbers, so 'trade when his cooldowns are down' had nothing concrete behind it.
audit.why: Haymaker (W) is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and Facebreaker (E) 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s; The Darkin Blade is 14/12/10/8/6s and Umbral Dash 9/8/7/6/5s; both ultimates are 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Rank-1 numbers for Haymaker (18s), Facebreaker (16s), Darkin Blade at rank 4 (8s) and World Ender (120s) written into the Levels 4-5 and Level 6 phases.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentioned that Aatrox's combo opens with a Deathbringer Stance (P) auto-attack reset — players were told to react to the Q cast.
audit.why: Deathbringer Stance carries the autoReset flag and heals off target max health; the reset wind-up precedes the Q chain, so it is the true step-back cue.
audit.corrected: Stated in dontsFull[0].d. Also corrected Sett's passive name to Pit Grit in spikes[3].text (packet flagged 'With Grit' as a suspect name).

audit.why: Executioner's Calling first back is already listed against his Deathbringer Stance / Umbral Dash / World Ender healing; that is the right anti-heal timing.

edits.before: Q gives move speed toward Aatrox and two empowered punches. Take short Q trades and back off before he can answer with World Ender.
edits.after: Knuckle Down gives move speed at him and two empowered punches, but his second Darkin Blade cast answers — short trades, then out.

edits.before: Facebreaker is online — the E-stun into double punch + W is your full pattern. Run it the moment Aatrox burns World Ender.
edits.after: All three Darkin Blade swings plus Umbral Dash out-trade one Haymaker. Facebreaker is up but 16s — stun, punch, leave, don't extend.

edits.before: Q ranks make your punch trades heavier, but Aatrox has his core tools too. Keep the grit bar honest: trade in, W-shield his return damage, out.
edits.after: His Darkin Blade is down to 8s and the outer sweetspot knocks up; your Haymaker is 18s at rank 1. Bank Grit off the wave and trade only on his miss.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Aatrox doesn't want. Suplex him into your wave or tower, never into his own minions.
edits.after: World Ender's 120s ramps his healing past your burst. The Show Stopper suppresses him mid-combo, but solo you lose the aftermath — bring the jungler.

edits.before: Stridebreaker fixes your only weakness — sticking to Aatrox. Shove, recall on the spike, and force the next trade before he matches your item.
edits.after: Eclipse spikes his burst and healing past your Stridebreaker. Executioner's Calling on the same back is what keeps you in the trade — buy it before you fight.

edits.before: That is Aatrox's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Deathbringer Stance auto-resets to open his combo — step back on that wind-up, not the Q.

edits.before: With Grit stacked and a full HP pool you can survive his combo and answer with W true damage. Late game evens out -- your R plays for the team as well as the duel, and his healing gets kited by Grievous.
edits.after: With Pit Grit stacked and a full HP pool you survive his combo and answer with Haymaker's true centre. Late game evens out -- The Show Stopper plays for the team as well as the duel, and Grievous cuts his drain.

notes: Level chart was inverted against the packet, the win rate and the mirror on five of seven rows; both layers agreed with each other but both were wrong, so the pairs are proposed together. Whether Facebreaker's stun condition is satisfied by minions on the far side is not in Riot's text and I did not assert it — same open question the mirror flagged.
